goal: Navigate the robot toward its goal while avoiding blocked paths.
strategy: The robot will navigate towards its goal by moving forward and turning as necessary to avoid obstacles. It will stop when it reaches the goal or when it cannot proceed safely.
decisions: If an obstacle is detected in front, turn LEFT.
If an obstacle is detected on the left, turn RIGHT.
If no direction is safe, STOP.
stop_condition: Reaching the goal or when no direction is safe to move into.
